title: 光纖陀螺儀~Fiber-optic gyroscopes
focus: 薩格納克相位、互易架構、線圈熱效應與散粒雜訊 ARW 的干涉式光纖陀螺工程~Sagnac phase, reciprocal architecture, coil thermal effects and shot-noise ARW in interferometric fiber-optic gyroscopes
summary: 以 1 km 線圈的干涉式光纖陀螺儀為對象，從薩格納克相位 Δφ = 2πLD·Ω/(λc) 與最小互易架構出發，建置寬頻光源、鈮酸鋰積體光學晶片、保偏光纖四極線圈與本徵頻率偏壓調制，再用轉台校正、艾倫偏差分離角度隨機漫步與零偏不穩定性，並以閉迴路鋸齒波回授與 IEEE 952 式測試完成導航級陀螺的驗收。~Taking a 1 km coil interferometric fiber-optic gyroscope as the object, this course starts from the Sagnac phase Δφ = 2πLD·Ω/(λc) and the minimum reciprocal configuration, builds the broadband source, lithium-niobate integrated-optic chip, quadrupole-wound polarization-maintaining coil and proper-frequency bias modulation, then separates angle random walk from bias instability with rate-table calibration and Allan deviation, and closes with closed-loop serrodyne feedback and IEEE 952-style tests for navigation-grade acceptance.

units.anchor: 薩格納克相位與線圈比例因子~Sagnac phase and coil scale factor
units.title: 薩格納克效應與光纖線圈的放大~The Sagnac effect and amplification by the fiber coil
units.mechanism: 在一個旋轉的閉合光路中，順時針與逆時針傳播的兩束光回到起點所需的時間不同，相位差 Δφ = 4π·A·Ω/(λc)，其中 A 是光路包圍的面積、Ω 是垂直於面積的旋轉速率。這個效應極小，但光纖可以把同一面積繞 N 圈：N 圈直徑 D 的線圈總面積 N·πD²/4，光纖長度 L = NπD，於是 Δφ = 2πLD·Ω/(λc)。光纖陀螺就是把一個長達公里的薩格納克干涉儀捲進手掌大小的線圈，比例因子由 L、D 與 λ 三個幾何與波長量決定，而與光纖折射率無關——這是薩格納克效應的相對論性本質。~In a rotating closed optical path the clockwise and counter-clockwise beams need different times to return to their starting point, with a phase difference Δφ = 4π·A·Ω/(λc), where A is the enclosed area and Ω the rotation rate normal to it. The effect is tiny, but fiber can wind the same area N times: a coil of N turns and diameter D encloses N·πD²/4 with fiber length L = NπD, so Δφ = 2πLD·Ω/(λc). A fiber-optic gyroscope is a kilometre-long Sagnac interferometer coiled into a palm-sized package; the scale factor is set by the geometric and wavelength quantities L, D and λ alone and not by the fiber's refractive index, which is the relativistic nature of the Sagnac effect.
units.model: 取 L = 1000 m、D = 0.1 m、λ = 1550 nm：S = 2πLD/(λc) = 2π×1000×0.1/(1550×10⁻⁹×2.998×10⁸) = 628.3/464.7 = 1.352 rad per rad/s。地球自轉 Ω_E = 7.292×10⁻⁵ rad/s（15.04°/h）給 Δφ = 98.6 µrad；1°/h = 4.848×10⁻⁶ rad/s 給 6.56 µrad；導航級要求的 0.01°/h 零偏對應 65.6 nrad，約為 1550 nm 一個波長的 10⁻⁸。~With L = 1000 m, D = 0.1 m and λ = 1550 nm: S = 2πLD/(λc) = 2π×1000×0.1/(1550×10⁻⁹×2.998×10⁸) = 628.3/464.7 = 1.352 rad per rad/s. Earth's rotation Ω_E = 7.292×10⁻⁵ rad/s (15.04°/h) gives Δφ = 98.6 µrad; 1°/h = 4.848×10⁻⁶ rad/s gives 6.56 µrad; the 0.01°/h bias required for navigation grade corresponds to 65.6 nrad, about 10⁻⁸ of one 1550 nm wavelength.
units.verify: 把陀螺的敏感軸朝北水平放置再轉到朝天，兩個方向讀值的差應等於 Ω_E·sin(緯度) 與 Ω_E·cos(緯度) 的組合；在台北（25°N）垂直軸應讀到 15.04×sin25° = 6.36°/h，水平朝北軸 13.63°/h。讀值與理論值的比值直接給出比例因子的初步校正。~Lay the gyroscope's sensitive axis horizontally pointing north, then turn it to point up; the two readings should correspond to combinations of Ω_E·sin(latitude) and Ω_E·cos(latitude). In Taipei (25°N) the vertical axis should read 15.04×sin25° = 6.36°/h and the horizontal north-pointing axis 13.63°/h; the ratio of reading to theory gives a first scale-factor calibration.
units.failure: 把線圈直徑從 100 mm 縮到 50 mm 以求小型化，卻沒有加長光纖，比例因子減半、相同雜訊下的角度隨機漫步加倍，原本導航級的設計變成戰術級。~Shrinking the coil diameter from 100 mm to 50 mm for compactness without adding fiber halves the scale factor, doubles the angle random walk at the same noise, and a navigation-grade design becomes tactical grade.
units.misconception: 光纖折射率越高，薩格納克相位越大，所以高折射率光纖能提高靈敏度。~A higher fiber refractive index enlarges the Sagnac phase, so high-index fiber raises sensitivity.

units.anchor: 最小互易架構與本徵頻率~Minimum reciprocal configuration and the proper frequency
units.title: 互易性、偏壓調制與工作點~Reciprocity, bias modulation and the operating point
units.mechanism: 要讓 10⁻⁸ 波長等級的非互易相位被看見，兩束光除了旋轉以外必須走完全相同的路：同一個單模、單偏振的空間濾波器（偏振器）、同一個耦合器埠進出、同一條光纖。這就是 Ulrich 的最小互易架構：任何互易的相位（溫度、壓力、波長變化）對兩束光相同而相消，只剩薩格納克相位。但干涉訊號 I ∝ 1 + cosΔφ 在 Δφ = 0 處斜率為零，於是在線圈一端加相位調制器，以線圈傳播時間 τ 為半週期的方波或正弦波調制，兩束光因在不同時刻經過調制器而獲得相差 π/2 的偏壓，工作點移到 cos 曲線的最大斜率處，並以同步解調讀出正負號。這個調制頻率 f_p = 1/(2τ) 稱為線圈的本徵頻率。~To see a non-reciprocal phase of 10⁻⁸ wavelengths, the two beams must travel exactly the same path apart from rotation: the same single-mode, single-polarization spatial filter (polarizer), the same coupler port in and out, the same fiber. This is Ulrich's minimum reciprocal configuration: every reciprocal phase (temperature, pressure, wavelength change) is identical for both beams and cancels, leaving only the Sagnac phase. But the interference signal I ∝ 1 + cosΔφ has zero slope at Δφ = 0, so a phase modulator at one end of the coil, driven by a square or sine wave whose half-period equals the coil transit time τ, biases the two beams by π/2 because they pass the modulator at different times; the operating point moves to the steepest part of the cosine and synchronous demodulation reads out the sign. This modulation frequency f_p = 1/(2τ) is the coil's proper frequency.
units.model: 線圈 L = 1000 m、n = 1.468：傳播時間 τ = nL/c = 1468/2.998×10⁸ = 4.90 µs，本徵頻率 f_p = 1/(2τ) = 102.1 kHz。在本徵頻率調制時，調制器引入的互易相位對兩束光剛好相差半個週期而給出 ±φ_m 的偏壓，且不會產生與調制同頻的假訊號；若用 50 kHz 調制，偏壓效率降為 sin(π×50/204) = 0.70，且調制器的任何幅度不對稱都變成零偏。~For a coil with L = 1000 m and n = 1.468 the transit time is τ = nL/c = 1468/2.998×10⁸ = 4.90 µs and the proper frequency f_p = 1/(2τ) = 102.1 kHz. Modulating at the proper frequency, the reciprocal phase from the modulator differs by exactly half a period between the beams, giving a ±φ_m bias without any spurious signal at the modulation frequency; modulating at 50 kHz instead reduces the bias efficiency to sin(π×50/204) = 0.70 and turns any amplitude asymmetry of the modulator into bias.
units.verify: 掃描調制頻率並記錄解調輸出中的二次諧波與零偏：在 f_p 處零偏對調制幅度的相依性應降到最低，二次諧波分量達極小值；量得的 f_p 反推出 nL，與光纖長度與群折射率的乘積比較，誤差應在 0.1% 內，這也是驗證線圈長度的簡便方法。~Sweep the modulation frequency while recording the second harmonic and the bias in the demodulated output: at f_p the dependence of bias on modulation amplitude should be minimal and the second-harmonic component reaches a minimum; the measured f_p yields nL, which should agree with the product of fiber length and group index within 0.1%, a convenient check of coil length.
units.failure: 為了省一個元件把偏振器拿掉，線圈中偏振耦合產生的非互易相位不再被濾除，零偏隨溫度在 ±1°/h 之間遊走，再多的訊號處理都救不回來。~Removing the polarizer to save a component lets non-reciprocal phase from polarization coupling in the coil pass unfiltered, the bias wanders by ±1°/h with temperature, and no amount of signal processing can recover it.
units.misconception: 只要兩束光在同一條光纖裡，任何干擾都自動相消，不需要偏振器。~As long as both beams share one fiber, every disturbance cancels automatically and no polarizer is needed.

units.anchor: ASE 寬頻光源與 LiNbO₃ 積體光學晶片~ASE broadband source and the LiNbO₃ integrated-optic chip
units.title: 光源相干性、積體光學晶片與偵測器~Source coherence, the integrated-optic chip and the detector
units.mechanism: 光纖陀螺故意使用低相干的寬頻光源（摻鉺光纖 ASE 光源或超輻射二極體 SLD），因為瑞利背向散射、光纖中的偏振交叉耦合與克爾效應都會產生與主光束干涉的寄生波；相干長度短到數十微米時，只有在線圈正中央極短一段內的散射才會相干相加，其餘全部變成非相干背景。核心元件是鈮酸鋰多功能積體光學晶片（MIOC）：質子交換波導同時做偏振器（消光比 > 60 dB）、Y 分支分束器與兩個電光相位調制器，頻寬達 GHz，使閉迴路運作成為可能。偵測器為 InGaAs PIN 光二極體加跨阻放大器，工作在 10–50 µW 的回光功率。~A FOG deliberately uses a low-coherence broadband source (an erbium-fiber ASE source or a superluminescent diode) because Rayleigh backscatter, polarization cross-coupling in the fiber and the Kerr effect all produce parasitic waves that interfere with the main beams; with a coherence length of tens of micrometres, only scatter from a very short segment at the exact centre of the coil adds coherently and everything else becomes incoherent background. The core component is the lithium-niobate multifunction integrated-optic chip (MIOC): proton-exchanged waveguides act simultaneously as polarizer (extinction above 60 dB), Y-junction splitter and two electro-optic phase modulators with gigahertz bandwidth, which makes closed-loop operation possible. The detector is an InGaAs PIN photodiode with a transimpedance amplifier operating at 10–50 µW of returned power.
units.model: ASE 光源中心 1550 nm、頻寬 Δλ = 30 nm：相干長度 L_c = λ²/(n·Δλ) = (1550×10⁻⁹)²/(1.468×30×10⁻⁹) = 54.6 µm，線圈中只有約 ±27 µm 的區段能產生相干背向散射。若改用線寬 1 MHz 的 DFB 雷射，L_c = c/(n·Δν) = 2.998×10⁸/(1.468×10⁶) = 204 m，整條 1 km 線圈的背向散射有五分之一會相干疊加，零偏將以數十°/h 隨溫度亂跳。~An ASE source centred at 1550 nm with Δλ = 30 nm has a coherence length L_c = λ²/(n·Δλ) = (1550×10⁻⁹)²/(1.468×30×10⁻⁹) = 54.6 µm, so only a segment of about ±27 µm in the coil can produce coherent backscatter. A DFB laser with a 1 MHz linewidth would instead have L_c = c/(n·Δν) = 2.998×10⁸/(1.468×10⁶) = 204 m, a fifth of the whole 1 km coil would backscatter coherently, and the bias would jump by tens of degrees per hour with temperature.
units.verify: 以光譜分析儀量光源的中心波長與 3 dB 頻寬，計算相干長度並與規格比對；以偏振消光比量測儀確認 MIOC 的消光比 > 60 dB；用網路分析儀量相位調制器的半波電壓 V_π 與頻寬，記錄 V_π 隨溫度的變化（約 0.1%/K）作為閉迴路第二迴路的設計輸入。~Measure the source's centre wavelength and 3 dB bandwidth with an optical spectrum analyser, compute the coherence length and compare with specification; confirm the MIOC extinction ratio above 60 dB with a polarization-extinction meter; measure the phase modulator's half-wave voltage V_π and bandwidth with a network analyser and record the V_π temperature dependence (about 0.1%/K) as input to the closed-loop second-loop design.
units.failure: 光源的中心波長隨泵浦電流與溫度漂移 1 nm，比例因子按 1/λ 變化 0.065%，即 650 ppm——比導航級 50 ppm 的要求大一個數量級，必須以摻鉺 ASE 加波長穩定濾波或量測波長補償。~The source's centre wavelength drifts by 1 nm with pump current and temperature, the scale factor changes as 1/λ by 0.065%, i.e. 650 ppm, an order of magnitude beyond the 50 ppm navigation-grade requirement, so an erbium ASE source with a wavelength-stabilising filter or measured-wavelength compensation is mandatory.
units.misconception: 雷射越單色、相干性越好，干涉儀就越靈敏，所以光纖陀螺應該用窄線寬雷射。~A more monochromatic, more coherent laser makes any interferometer more sensitive, so a FOG should use a narrow-linewidth laser.

units.anchor: 保偏光纖四極繞法線圈與舒佩效應~Quadrupole-wound PM coil and the Shupe effect
units.title: 線圈繞製、熱瞬態與舒佩效應~Coil winding, thermal transients and the Shupe effect
units.mechanism: 最小互易架構消除的是靜態的互易相位；若溫度在光傳播的 τ 期間改變，兩束光在不同時刻經過同一段光纖，看到的折射率不同，產生非互易相位——這就是舒佩效應，它正比於溫度變化速率沿光纖的不對稱分佈。對策是把線圈繞成四極對稱：把光纖從中點對折，兩半以 +−−+ 的順序交替成層，使距中點等距的兩段光纖在空間上相鄰、溫度幾乎相同。線圈用保偏光纖（熊貓或領結型）、低應力膠固化，並控制張力與層間交叉點，因為每一個交叉都是偏振耦合點。~The minimum reciprocal configuration removes static reciprocal phase; if temperature changes during the transit time τ, the two beams pass the same fiber segment at different instants, see different refractive indices and acquire a non-reciprocal phase, the Shupe effect, proportional to the asymmetric distribution of the temperature rate along the fiber. The countermeasure is quadrupole-symmetric winding: the fiber is folded at its midpoint and the two halves are layered alternately in a +−−+ sequence so that segments equidistant from the midpoint lie spatially adjacent at nearly the same temperature. The coil uses polarization-maintaining fiber (PANDA or bow-tie), low-stress potting and controlled tension and layer crossovers, because every crossover is a polarization-coupling point.
units.model: 舒佩相位 Δφ_S = (2πn/(λc))·(dn/dT)·∫₀ᴸ Ṫ(z)(2z − L)dz。若溫度變化速率沿光纖線性不對稱、兩端差 ΔṪ = 0.01 K/min = 1.67×10⁻⁴ K/s，積分 = ΔṪ·L²/6 = 27.8 K·m²/s；取 dn/dT = 1×10⁻⁵/K、L = 1000 m：Δφ_S = (2π×1.468/(1550×10⁻⁹×2.998×10⁸))×10⁻⁵×27.8 = 5.5 µrad，等效旋轉速率 5.5×10⁻⁶/1.352 = 4.1×10⁻⁶ rad/s = 0.84°/h。四極繞法把不對稱性壓低約 100 倍後約為 0.008°/h，才能接近導航級。~The Shupe phase is Δφ_S = (2πn/(λc))·(dn/dT)·∫₀ᴸ Ṫ(z)(2z − L)dz. For a temperature rate varying linearly and asymmetrically along the fiber with an end-to-end difference ΔṪ = 0.01 K/min = 1.67×10⁻⁴ K/s, the integral is ΔṪ·L²/6 = 27.8 K·m²/s; with dn/dT = 1×10⁻⁵/K and L = 1000 m, Δφ_S = (2π×1.468/(1550×10⁻⁹×2.998×10⁸))×10⁻⁵×27.8 = 5.5 µrad, an equivalent rotation rate of 5.5×10⁻⁶/1.352 = 4.1×10⁻⁶ rad/s = 0.84°/h. Quadrupole winding reduces the asymmetry about 100-fold to roughly 0.008°/h, which is what brings the coil near navigation grade.
units.verify: 把線圈放在溫箱中以 1 K/min 的速率升降溫並同步記錄零偏與線圈多點溫度，計算零偏對溫度變化速率的靈敏度（°/h 每 K/min）；四極線圈應比同長度的簡單螺旋線圈低兩個數量級。用 OFDR 或偏振串擾分析儀沿光纖掃描交叉耦合點，確認每個交叉的耦合低於 −40 dB。~Place the coil in a thermal chamber ramped at 1 K/min up and down while logging bias and several coil temperatures, and compute the bias sensitivity to temperature rate (°/h per K/min); a quadrupole coil should be two orders below a simple helical coil of the same length. Scan the cross-coupling points along the fiber with OFDR or a polarization-crosstalk analyser, confirming that each crossover couples below −40 dB.
units.failure: 膠固化時收縮不均在線圈內部留下徑向應力梯度，溫度循環後光纖局部雙折射改變，零偏出現 0.1°/h 的遲滯，無法用溫度模型補償，整個線圈報廢。~Uneven shrinkage of the potting leaves a radial stress gradient inside the coil; after thermal cycling the local birefringence changes, the bias shows 0.1°/h of hysteresis that no temperature model can compensate, and the whole coil is scrapped.
units.misconception: 只要線圈整體溫度穩定，光纖陀螺就不會有熱致零偏。~If the coil's overall temperature is stable, a FOG has no thermally induced bias.

units.anchor: 速率轉台、溫箱與艾倫偏差~Rate table, thermal chamber and Allan deviation
units.title: 比例因數校正、零偏模型與雜訊指標~Scale-factor calibration, bias model and noise metrics
units.mechanism: 陀螺的校正有三件事：比例因數（輸出對輸入速率的斜率與線性度，在速率轉台上以 ±0.1 到 ±500°/s 的多點量測）、零偏及其溫度模型（在溫箱中靜置，扣除地球自轉分量後對溫度與溫度速率擬合多項式）、以及雜訊指標。雜訊以艾倫偏差 σ(τ) 分解：斜率 −1/2 的區段是角度隨機漫步（ARW，單位 °/√h），平坦區是零偏不穩定性（閃爍雜訊，單位 °/h），斜率 +1/2 是速率隨機漫步。ARW 的理論下限由偵測器光電流的散粒雜訊決定，是評估光學設計是否達標的第一個數字。~Calibrating a gyroscope covers three things: the scale factor (slope and linearity of output versus input rate, measured at many points from ±0.1 to ±500°/s on a rate table), the bias and its temperature model (static in a thermal chamber, fitting a polynomial in temperature and temperature rate after removing the Earth-rate component), and the noise metrics. Noise is decomposed with the Allan deviation σ(τ): the −1/2 slope region is angle random walk (ARW, in °/√h), the flat region is bias instability (flicker noise, in °/h), and the +1/2 slope is rate random walk. The theoretical ARW floor is set by shot noise of the detector photocurrent and is the first number used to judge whether the optical design is adequate.
units.model: 工作點光電流 I = 18 µA（回光 20 µW、響應度 0.9 A/W）：散粒雜訊相位 δφ = √(2e/I) = √(2×1.602×10⁻¹⁹/18×10⁻⁶) = 1.33×10⁻⁷ rad/√Hz；除以 S = 1.352 得 9.87×10⁻⁸ rad/s/√Hz = 5.65×10⁻⁶ °/s/√Hz；換算 °/√h 乘 60 得 ARW_shot = 3.4×10⁻⁴ °/√h。導航級常要求 ARW ≤ 2×10⁻³ °/√h，此設計留有六倍餘裕給其他雜訊。~At an operating-point photocurrent I = 18 µA (20 µW returned, 0.9 A/W responsivity) the shot-noise phase is δφ = √(2e/I) = √(2×1.602×10⁻¹⁹/18×10⁻⁶) = 1.33×10⁻⁷ rad/√Hz; dividing by S = 1.352 gives 9.87×10⁻⁸ rad/s/√Hz = 5.65×10⁻⁶ °/s/√Hz, and multiplying by 60 to convert to °/√h gives ARW_shot = 3.4×10⁻⁴ °/√h. Navigation grade typically asks for ARW ≤ 2×10⁻³ °/√h, so this design leaves a six-fold margin for other noise sources.
units.verify: 在隔振基座上靜置記錄 12 小時、取樣 100 Hz，計算艾倫偏差並以直線擬合 τ = 0.01–1 s 區段讀 ARW、以最低點讀零偏不穩定性；在速率轉台上以 ±1、±10、±100°/s 各量 60 s，擬合比例因數並計算非線性與不對稱性（ppm）；在溫箱 −40 到 +70 °C 間以 0.5 K/min 循環三次，擬合零偏溫度模型並記錄殘差。~Record 12 hours static on an isolated base at 100 Hz, compute the Allan deviation, read ARW from a straight-line fit over τ = 0.01–1 s and bias instability from the minimum; on a rate table measure 60 s each at ±1, ±10 and ±100°/s, fit the scale factor and compute nonlinearity and asymmetry in ppm; cycle the thermal chamber three times between −40 and +70 °C at 0.5 K/min, fit the bias temperature model and record the residuals.
units.failure: 校正時以 1 s 平均的資料估 ARW，卻沒注意資料已被輸出濾波器限頻，艾倫偏差在短 τ 處被人為壓低，報出比散粒雜訊極限還好的 ARW，上機後導航誤差比預測大三倍。~Estimating ARW from 1 s averaged data without noticing that the output filter has already band-limited it artificially lowers the Allan deviation at short τ, an ARW better than the shot-noise limit is reported, and navigation error in service is three times the prediction.
units.misconception: 零偏不穩定性只要平均夠久就會消失，和 ARW 一樣可以靠積分時間改善。~Bias instability disappears with long enough averaging, just like ARW.

units.anchor: 光源 RIN、背向散射、克爾與法拉第效應~Source RIN, backscatter, Kerr and Faraday effects
units.title: 雜訊與零偏誤差預算~Noise and bias error budget
units.mechanism: 散粒雜訊之外，寬頻光源的相對強度雜訊（RIN）是 ARW 的主要來源：ASE 光源的 RIN 約等於光學頻寬的倒數，在工作點上強度起伏與相位起伏 1:1 對應。零偏誤差則來自：殘餘相干背向散射、克爾效應（兩方向功率不等時非線性折射率造成的非互易相位，可用方波調制與 50% 佔空比抑制）、法拉第效應（地磁場經光纖扭轉耦合產生非互易相位，需 µ 金屬屏蔽）、偏振非互易（由偏振器消光比與光纖 h 參數決定）以及電子學的解調偏移。預算表把每一項以 °/h 或 °/√h 列出，均方根合成後對照等級要求。~Beyond shot noise, the relative intensity noise (RIN) of the broadband source is the main contributor to ARW: an ASE source's RIN is roughly the inverse of its optical bandwidth, and at the operating point intensity fluctuations map one to one onto phase. Bias errors come from residual coherent backscatter, the Kerr effect (non-reciprocal phase from the nonlinear index when the two directions carry unequal power, suppressed by square-wave modulation at 50% duty cycle), the Faraday effect (non-reciprocal phase from the geomagnetic field coupled through fiber twist, requiring mu-metal shielding), polarization non-reciprocity (set by polarizer extinction and the fiber h-parameter) and demodulation offsets in the electronics. The budget lists each item in °/h or °/√h and compares the root-sum-square with the grade requirement.
units.model: 30 nm 頻寬對應 Δν = cΔλ/λ² = 3.74 THz，RIN ≈ 1/Δν = 2.67×10⁻¹³/Hz（−125.7 dB/Hz）；工作點的等效相位雜訊 √RIN = 5.17×10⁻⁷ rad/√Hz，是散粒雜訊 1.33×10⁻⁷ 的 3.9 倍，對應 ARW_RIN = 1.31×10⁻³ °/√h。合成 ARW = √(3.4² + 13.1²)×10⁻⁴ = 1.36×10⁻³ °/√h，仍在 2×10⁻³ 的導航級要求內，但表示 RIN 抑制（參考光二極體相減或放大器增益調制）是下一步改善的方向。~A 30 nm bandwidth corresponds to Δν = cΔλ/λ² = 3.74 THz, so RIN ≈ 1/Δν = 2.67×10⁻¹³/Hz (−125.7 dB/Hz); the equivalent phase noise at the operating point is √RIN = 5.17×10⁻⁷ rad/√Hz, 3.9 times the shot noise of 1.33×10⁻⁷, giving ARW_RIN = 1.31×10⁻³ °/√h. The combined ARW = √(3.4² + 13.1²)×10⁻⁴ = 1.36×10⁻³ °/√h, still within the 2×10⁻³ navigation-grade requirement, but it shows that RIN suppression (subtraction with a reference photodiode or gain modulation) is the next improvement.
units.verify: 用第二個光二極體直接監測光源強度並量 RIN 頻譜，確認在 f_p 附近約 −126 dB/Hz；把陀螺放進亥姆霍茲線圈中施加 ±1 高斯（100 µT）三軸磁場，量零偏變化得到磁靈敏度（°/h/G），屏蔽後應低於 0.01°/h/G；把光源功率改變 ±3 dB，零偏的變化量即克爾與背向散射項的上界。~Monitor the source intensity directly with a second photodiode and measure the RIN spectrum, confirming about −126 dB/Hz near f_p; place the gyroscope in Helmholtz coils applying ±1 gauss (100 µT) along three axes and measure the bias change to obtain magnetic sensitivity (°/h/G), which after shielding should be below 0.01°/h/G; change source power by ±3 dB, the bias change bounding the Kerr and backscatter terms.
units.failure: 為了提高回光功率改用窄頻 10 nm 的光源，RIN 升高三倍，ARW 惡化到 4×10⁻³ °/√h，同時相干長度變長使背向散射零偏增加，兩項指標同時跌出導航級。~Switching to a narrower 10 nm source to raise returned power triples the RIN, ARW worsens to 4×10⁻³ °/√h, and the longer coherence length raises backscatter bias, so both metrics fall out of navigation grade together.
units.misconception: 回光功率越高越好，因為散粒雜訊相對變小。~Higher returned power is always better because shot noise becomes relatively smaller.

units.anchor: 數位相位斜坡與閉迴路回授~Digital phase ramp and closed-loop feedback
units.title: 閉迴路運作、比例因數穩定與 IMU 整合~Closed-loop operation, scale-factor stability and IMU integration
units.mechanism: 開迴路陀螺的輸出是 sinΔφ，只在小角度線性；閉迴路把薩格納克相位用 MIOC 的相位調制器即時抵消：每個傳播時間 τ 把回授相位增加一個台階 Δφ_S（數位相位斜坡），累積到 2π 時重置，斜坡的頻率就正比於旋轉速率，而干涉儀永遠工作在零相位附近。這樣輸出對速率的線性度不再依賴 cos 曲線，而只依賴 2π 重置的準確度，所以第二個伺服迴路持續校正調制器的 V_2π，把電光係數的溫漂（約 0.1%/K）消除。三軸陀螺與三軸加速度計組成 IMU，軸間正交性以轉台校正到 100 µrad 內。~An open-loop gyroscope outputs sinΔφ, linear only at small angles; closed loop cancels the Sagnac phase in real time with the MIOC phase modulator: every transit time τ the feedback phase steps by Δφ_S (a digital phase ramp) and resets when 2π is reached, the ramp frequency is proportional to the rotation rate, and the interferometer always works near zero phase. Linearity then no longer depends on the cosine curve but only on the accuracy of the 2π reset, so a second servo loop continuously calibrates the modulator's V_2π and removes the electro-optic coefficient's temperature drift (about 0.1%/K). Three gyroscopes with three accelerometers form an IMU whose inter-axis orthogonality is calibrated on a rate table to within 100 µrad.
units.model: 100°/s = 1.745 rad/s 的輸入給 Δφ_S = 1.352×1.745 = 2.36 rad，每 τ = 4.90 µs 台階 2.36 rad，相位斜坡頻率 = 2.36/(2π×4.90×10⁻⁶) = 76.7 kHz；0.01°/h 時台階僅 65.6 nrad，斜坡 2π 重置週期長達 10⁵ 秒。動態範圍 = 1000°/s ÷ 0.001°/h = 3.6×10⁹，開迴路的 sin 曲線完全無法涵蓋。V_2π 伺服把 2π 重置誤差控制在 10⁻⁵，比例因數因此穩定到約 10 ppm。~An input of 100°/s = 1.745 rad/s gives Δφ_S = 1.352×1.745 = 2.36 rad, a step of 2.36 rad every τ = 4.90 µs and a phase-ramp frequency of 2.36/(2π×4.90×10⁻⁶) = 76.7 kHz; at 0.01°/h the step is only 65.6 nrad and the 2π reset period stretches to 10⁵ s. The dynamic range is 1000°/s ÷ 0.001°/h = 3.6×10⁹, which an open-loop sine curve could never cover. The V_2π servo holds the 2π reset error at 10⁻⁵, stabilising the scale factor to about 10 ppm.
units.verify: 在速率轉台上以 ±1、±10、±100、±500°/s 量輸出，計算比例因數的線性度與不對稱性，閉迴路後應 < 20 ppm；觀察 2π 重置瞬間的偵測器尖峰，確認 V_2π 伺服收斂後尖峰消失；把溫度從 −40 升到 +70 °C，比例因數變化應 < 50 ppm，否則 V_2π 伺服增益不足。~Measure output on a rate table at ±1, ±10, ±100 and ±500°/s and compute scale-factor linearity and asymmetry, which should be below 20 ppm in closed loop; watch the detector spike at each 2π reset and confirm it vanishes once the V_2π servo converges; raise the temperature from −40 to +70 °C, and a scale-factor change above 50 ppm indicates insufficient V_2π servo gain.
units.failure: 閉迴路數位斜坡的 DAC 只有 12 位元，最小相位台階 2π/4096 = 1.5 mrad 遠大於 65.6 nrad 的導航級台階，低速率時輸出出現量化死區，慣性導航在靜止時漂移。~A 12-bit DAC in the closed-loop digital ramp gives a minimum phase step of 2π/4096 = 1.5 mrad, far above the 65.6 nrad navigation-grade step, the output shows a quantisation dead zone at low rates and the inertial navigation drifts while stationary.
units.misconception: 閉迴路只是為了擴大量程，對低速率的精度沒有幫助。~Closed loop only extends the range and does nothing for low-rate precision.

units.anchor: IEEE 952 式測試與驗收報告~IEEE 952-style tests and acceptance record
units.title: 驗證程序、等級判定與工程交接~Verification procedures, grade determination and engineering handoff
units.mechanism: 光纖陀螺的驗收遵循公開的測試標準（IEEE Std 952 為單軸干涉式光纖陀螺的測試程序）：以艾倫偏差報告 ARW 與零偏不穩定性、以轉台報告比例因數及其線性度與重複性、以溫箱報告零偏與比例因數的溫度係數、以磁場與振動測試報告環境靈敏度。等級由這些數字共同決定：導航級通常指零偏不穩定性 ≤ 0.01°/h、ARW ≤ 0.002°/√h、比例因數 ≤ 50 ppm。交接文件包含每台陀螺的序號、所有校正係數（比例因數、零偏溫度模型、軸對準矩陣）、艾倫偏差圖、以及可追溯的轉台與溫箱校正證書。~FOG acceptance follows public test standards (IEEE Std 952 for single-axis interferometric fiber-optic gyros): ARW and bias instability are reported from the Allan deviation, scale factor with its linearity and repeatability from the rate table, temperature coefficients of bias and scale factor from the thermal chamber, and environmental sensitivity from magnetic and vibration tests. The grade follows from these numbers together: navigation grade usually means bias instability ≤ 0.01°/h, ARW ≤ 0.002°/√h and scale factor ≤ 50 ppm. The handoff file contains each gyroscope's serial number, all calibration coefficients (scale factor, bias temperature model, axis-alignment matrix), the Allan deviation plot and traceable calibration certificates for the rate table and thermal chamber.
units.model: 以第 6 單元的 ARW = 1.35×10⁻³ °/√h 與零偏不穩定性 B = 0.005°/h（教學假設）預測艾倫偏差：σ(τ) = ARW/√τ，τ = 1 s（= 1/3600 h）時 σ = 1.35×10⁻³×60 = 0.081°/h，τ = 100 s 時 0.0081°/h；平坦區的值為 0.664·B = 0.0033°/h，與 ARW 線相交於 √τ_h = 1.35×10⁻³/3.3×10⁻³ → τ ≈ 0.165 h ≈ 600 s。驗收時實測曲線的最低點須 ≤ 0.664×0.01 = 0.0066°/h 且出現在 τ ≥ 300 s，才判定為導航級。~Using the unit-6 ARW = 1.35×10⁻³ °/√h and a bias instability B = 0.005°/h (teaching assumption), the predicted Allan deviation is σ(τ) = ARW/√τ: at τ = 1 s (= 1/3600 h) σ = 1.35×10⁻³×60 = 0.081°/h, at τ = 100 s 0.0081°/h; the flat region sits at 0.664·B = 0.0033°/h and meets the ARW line at √τ_h = 1.35×10⁻³/3.3×10⁻³ → τ ≈ 0.165 h ≈ 600 s. For acceptance, the measured curve's minimum must be ≤ 0.664×0.01 = 0.0066°/h and occur at τ ≥ 300 s to qualify as navigation grade.
units.verify: 依標準順序執行：靜態 12 小時艾倫偏差、轉台多速率比例因數（含正反轉）、溫箱三次循環、三軸磁場、隨機振動後重測零偏；把每項結果與門檻並列成驗收表，任何一項未達標即判定等級降級；交接時附上原始資料檔與處理腳本，使後續可重算。~Execute in standard order: a 12 hour static Allan deviation, multi-rate scale factor on the table including both directions, three thermal cycles, three-axis magnetic field, and bias remeasured after random vibration; tabulate each result against its threshold as the acceptance sheet, any failing item lowering the grade; at handoff attach the raw data files and processing scripts so that everything can be recomputed.
units.failure: 驗收只做 2 小時靜態測試，艾倫偏差尚未到達平坦區就外推零偏不穩定性，報出 0.004°/h；實際的閃爍底是 0.02°/h，裝機後慣導系統 1 小時位置誤差比規格大五倍。~An acceptance with only a 2 hour static test extrapolates bias instability before the Allan curve reaches its floor and reports 0.004°/h; the real flicker floor is 0.02°/h, and the installed navigation system's 1 hour position error is five times specification.
units.misconception: 只要 ARW 達標，陀螺就是導航級。~Meeting the ARW specification alone makes a gyroscope navigation grade.

example: 導航級光纖陀螺設計核對：L = 1000 m、D = 0.1 m、λ = 1550 nm，比例因子 S = 2πLD/(λc) = 1.352 rad per rad/s；地球自轉 7.292×10⁻⁵ rad/s 給 98.6 µrad，1°/h 給 6.56 µrad。線圈傳播時間 τ = nL/c = 4.90 µs，本徵頻率 f_p = 102.1 kHz。光源 30 nm ASE：相干長度 54.6 µm，RIN ≈ 1/3.74 THz = 2.67×10⁻¹³/Hz。雜訊：I = 18 µA 的散粒雜訊相位 1.33×10⁻⁷ rad/√Hz → ARW_shot = 3.4×10⁻⁴ °/√h；RIN 相位 5.17×10⁻⁷ rad/√Hz → 1.31×10⁻³ °/√h；合成 ARW ≈ 1.36×10⁻³ °/√h。熱：端對端 0.01 K/min 的不對稱升溫速率給舒佩相位 5.5 µrad = 0.84°/h，四極繞法壓到約 0.008°/h。閉迴路：100°/s 時相位斜坡 76.7 kHz，動態範圍 3.6×10⁹。艾倫偏差預測：σ(1 s) = 0.081°/h，與 0.005°/h 零偏不穩定性的平坦區（0.0033°/h）交於 τ ≈ 600 s，符合導航級門檻。所有數值皆為教學假設，不代表任何產品規格。~Navigation-grade FOG design check: L = 1000 m, D = 0.1 m, λ = 1550 nm, scale factor S = 2πLD/(λc) = 1.352 rad per rad/s; Earth's rotation of 7.292×10⁻⁵ rad/s gives 98.6 µrad and 1°/h gives 6.56 µrad. Coil transit time τ = nL/c = 4.90 µs, proper frequency f_p = 102.1 kHz. A 30 nm ASE source has a coherence length of 54.6 µm and RIN ≈ 1/3.74 THz = 2.67×10⁻¹³/Hz. Noise: shot-noise phase at I = 18 µA is 1.33×10⁻⁷ rad/√Hz → ARW_shot = 3.4×10⁻⁴ °/√h; RIN phase 5.17×10⁻⁷ rad/√Hz → 1.31×10⁻³ °/√h; combined ARW ≈ 1.36×10⁻³ °/√h. Thermal: an end-to-end asymmetric heating rate of 0.01 K/min gives a Shupe phase of 5.5 µrad = 0.84°/h, reduced to about 0.008°/h by quadrupole winding. Closed loop: at 100°/s the phase ramp runs at 76.7 kHz and the dynamic range is 3.6×10⁹. Allan prediction: σ(1 s) = 0.081°/h, meeting the 0.0033°/h floor of a 0.005°/h bias instability at τ ≈ 600 s, within the navigation-grade threshold. All values are teaching assumptions, not any product's specification.
history: 1913 年薩格納克以旋轉的環形干涉儀證明旋轉會產生條紋位移；1976 年 Vali 與 Shorthill 在猶他大學用光纖線圈首次展示光纖陀螺。1980 年 Ulrich 提出最小互易架構、Shupe 分析出熱瞬態誤差，奠定了實用設計的兩大基礎；1980–90 年代 Lefèvre 等人在法國（Thomson-CSF、Photonetics，後成為 iXsea／iXblue，現為 Exail）發展出閉迴路數位相位斜坡與鈮酸鋰積體光學晶片，Honeywell 與 Northrop Grumman 則把光纖陀螺用於航空、船艦與太空慣性量測單元。今日光纖陀螺涵蓋戰術級到戰略級，是無 GNSS 環境下導航的主要慣性感測器之一。本課只重建公開原理與測試方法。~In 1913 Sagnac showed with a rotating ring interferometer that rotation shifts interference fringes; in 1976 Vali and Shorthill at the University of Utah demonstrated the first fiber-optic gyroscope with a fiber coil. In 1980 Ulrich proposed the minimum reciprocal configuration and Shupe analysed the thermal-transient error, the two foundations of practical design; through the 1980s and 1990s Lefèvre and colleagues in France (Thomson-CSF, Photonetics, later iXsea/iXblue and now Exail) developed the closed-loop digital phase ramp and the lithium-niobate integrated-optic chip, while Honeywell and Northrop Grumman applied FOGs to aircraft, ships and spacecraft inertial measurement units. FOGs today span tactical to strategic grade and are among the main inertial sensors for navigation without GNSS; this course reconstructs only public principles and test methods.
